# Branding

## `social-card.png` — the GitHub social preview

1280×640, generated by [`Tools/MakeSocialCard.swift`](../../Tools/MakeSocialCard.swift)
rather than checked in as an unexplained binary, so it can be re-rendered when
the pitch or the palette moves:

```sh
swiftc -O Tools/MakeSocialCard.swift -o /tmp/makecard && /tmp/makecard .github/branding/social-card.png
```

**It has to be uploaded by hand.** GitHub exposes no API for the social preview
image; it is *Settings → General → Social preview → Upload an image*. Until
someone does that, every link to this repository — in Slack, in Discord, on
Hacker News, in a tweet — unfurls as GitHub's default card of an avatar and a
repo name. For a video library that is the single most-seen impression the
project has, spent on nothing.

The same card works for the companion repositories; the wordmark is the
ecosystem's, not this package's.
